intro: Recovered from a locked strongbox atop Tiragarde Keep, these weathered papers bear the personal seal of the late Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore. The recovered orders reveal that the Kul Tiran human garrison along Durotar's coast is far more entrenched and organized than simple shipwreck survivors. Delivering them to Gar'Thok in Razor Hill exposes lingering military plans threatening the fledgling Orc nation.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You open the aged and weathered envelope and discover an official looking document. You recognize the seal of Admiral Proudmoore.
This looks important. Perhaps Gar'Thok, the commander of Razor Hill, would be interested in having this information.

clips.title: Progress
paras: There is a look of concern on your face, adventurer. What have you there?

clips.title: Completion
paras: This does not bode well at all. You were wise to bring this information to my attention.
